items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: I became a member of jazz at the Philharmonic

ctx.x: Maybe it's your whole approach, your attitude, you know?

Maybe, it's something because I don't have problems like that. I remember, now the fellow that really did a whole lot was Norman Granz. Norman used to take us places and go in hotels where they didn't have colored. Norman said, they're going to stay here, and we stayed, and everybody was so sweet. Of course, every once in a while one of the boys would try and show off. But they was just always so sweet to me and I had all kinds of service, just everything.
Sometimes it's the way things are
